title: a reopened issue keeps the labels of the claim that ended with its close
status: fixed after 0.5.0: the coordinator frees a reopened issue of the labels its ended claim left (DESIGN.md, 13)
world: memory; the git world runs it over real git (build step 6)

steps.note: the owner reopened #1 after a's pull request merged and the repository deleted claude/1, so no branch stands for it and the claim ended with the close: the coordinator puts todo on, then takes worker:a, in-review and, last, claimed off, and the Queue lists #1 again; until the fix the issue kept them, shown in neither the Queue nor Claims, and under the mutant that frees nothing it still does, G8 red here; under the one that puts todo on last, G8 is red here too

the owner closed #1 and opened it again while b's pull request, marked ready, waits for review: that finishes the claim, so the coordinator takes nothing off; under the mutant that takes a ready pull request's in-review off, G8 is red here

the repository keeps head branches, so claude/1 stands after the merge, and the owner reopens #1 an hour after b's last commit: a claim branch is a claim whatever the labels say, so the coordinator takes in-review alone off; under the mutant that reads no claim branch for the issue the coordinator plans to free it wholly and, reading claude/1 again, frees nothing, and under the one that leaves in-review on where a branch stands nothing comes off either, G8 red here for each
b's claim has gone a day without a commit and is released as any idle claim is

the branch b's release left still stands, but that release came at hour 26, before a's merge closed #1 at hour 27, so it is no release being undone: the claim ended with the close, and the coordinator frees #1 wholly; until F22's review the released branch counted, so in-review alone came off and claimed and worker:a stayed on an issue with no claim branch, listed in no section, for good; under the mutant that reads a release comment before the last close as an undo, G8 is red here

the owner reopens #1 a day after a's last commit: the coordinator takes in-review off, and the claim, idle now, is released in the same run; under the mutant that reads the releases due before the freeing, it waits for the next run, G3 red here

the owner put claimed back on the reopened #1 to undo the release, which came after #1 was last closed, so the released branch beside it is a release being undone, and the coordinator takes nothing off; under the mutant that reads no released branch for the issue, it frees it, taking claimed off, G8 red here
